description: BUG 2 (Public/frontend-v6): PWA app-shortcut icons (Expenses, Loans, Committee, Downloads, Donate) render as blank white squares in Android/Chrome's long-press shortcut menu, while the app launcher icon and the browser 'Site settings' gear render fine. Root cause: the shortcuts in Public/frontend-v6/vite.config.ts point at /icons/icon-192.png, which is a 192x192 RGBA PNG (color type 6) with a FULLY TRANSPARENT background — Android's shortcut sheet renders such an icon on white (or crops the transparent artwork away), showing a blank square. Fix by pointing the shortcut icons at an OPAQUE, adequately-padded square icon (add a small non-transparent shortcut icon asset with the diya on the brand background, OR reuse an existing opaque asset), and set appropriate sizes/purpose. Independent of FEAT-001; touch Public/frontend-v6 only.
steps: Confirm baseline: from Public/frontend-v6 run `npm run build` and confirm it succeeds and .svelte-kit/output/client/manifest.webmanifest currently lists each shortcut with icons -> /icons/icon-192.png.

Verify the transparency root cause: icon-192.png is PNG color type 6 (RGBA) with a transparent background (the app icons array intentionally reuses it with purpose 'any'/'maskable'). The main app icon renders because the launcher composites it on the app's own tile; the shortcut sheet does not, so it needs an opaque square.

Create a small OPAQUE shortcut icon asset under Public/frontend-v6/static/icons/ (e.g. icon-shortcut-192.png): a 192x192 (or 96x96, the size Android's launcher typically requests for shortcuts) PNG with NO alpha transparency — the diya artwork centered with adequate padding on the brand background color (#F27A1A theme or a solid tile that matches the app's look). Keep the file small. Generate it deterministically if a generator script exists under Public/frontend-v6/scripts/ (check scripts/gen-screenshots.mjs style); otherwise produce a minimal opaque PNG programmatically. Ensure the produced PNG is genuinely opaque (color type 2 RGB, or RGBA with all alpha=255).

In Public/frontend-v6/vite.config.ts, update every entry in the manifest.shortcuts array so its icons array points at the new opaque asset with sizes matching the asset and purpose 'any', e.g. icons: [{ src: '/icons/icon-shortcut-192.png', sizes '192x192', type: 'image/png', purpose: 'any' }]. Update the explanatory comment above the shortcuts array to reflect that shortcut icons must be OPAQUE (not the transparent app icon) so the Android shortcut sheet renders the diya instead of a white square.

If frontend-v6 has a manifest/vite test pattern for the PWA config, add or adjust a vitest test (e.g. src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts) asserting that every shortcut in the vite.config manifest has an icons entry whose src is the intended opaque asset (not /icons/icon-192.png). If importing vite.config.ts directly is impractical, instead add a test that reads static/icons/<new asset> and asserts it is a non-transparent PNG (color type 2, or RGBA with no transparent pixels in the corners), and document that the built manifest is the source of truth. Do not over-engineer — one focused test.

Run `npm run build` and inspect .svelte-kit/output/client/manifest.webmanifest to confirm each of the 5 shortcuts now references the opaque asset with the correct sizes/purpose and no longer references the transparent icon-192.png.
acceptance_criteria: A new opaque (no-transparency) shortcut icon asset exists under Public/frontend-v6/static/icons/ with the diya on a solid background.
Every shortcut in Public/frontend-v6/vite.config.ts (Expenses, Loans, Committee, Downloads, Donate) references the opaque shortcut icon with appropriate sizes and purpose 'any'.
After `npm run build`, .svelte-kit/output/client/manifest.webmanifest shows all 5 shortcut icons pointing at the opaque asset and none pointing at the transparent /icons/icon-192.png.
`npm run check` passes with no new svelte-check warnings/errors and `npm test` (vitest) passes, including any added manifest/icon test.
`npm run build` succeeds and stays within the public-frontend-v6 JS-size budget (build not made larger by JS).
verification: cd Public/frontend-v6 && npm run check && npm test && npm run build — all succeed.
Inspect .svelte-kit/output/client/manifest.webmanifest: each shortcut icon src is the new opaque asset; verify the asset file is a non-transparent PNG (e.g. via a byte/color-type check).
Read any added test to confirm it fails if the shortcut icons are pointed back at the transparent icon-192.png.
findings: Confirmed root cause: static/icons/icon-192.png is 192x192 8-bit RGBA (PNG color type 6) with a transparent background; the app `icons` array reuses it. Created a dedicated OPAQUE asset static/icons/icon-shortcut-192.png (192x192, color type 2 RGB, ~17.8KB) by compositing the diya over the solid brand background (#F27A1A). `sharp` (used by the existing scripts/gen-icons.mjs and gen-screenshots.mjs) is NOT installed and is not a committed dep, so I wrote scripts/gen-shortcut-icon.mjs which is dependency-free: it decodes icon-192.png and re-encodes with node:zlib only, so the build needs no extra install. Pointed all 5 shortcuts (Expenses, Loans, Committee, Downloads, Donate) at the opaque asset with sizes 192x192, type image/png, purpose 'any', and rewrote the explanatory comment to say shortcut icons must be OPAQUE. Added prove-first test src/lib/pwaManifest.test.ts (reads vite.config.ts source + asset PNG headers); verified it FAILS when shortcuts are pointed back at icon-192.png. Verification (PATH prepended with node v22.23.2): `npm run check` 0 errors/0 warnings (the Vite native-configLoader notice about the existing ./src/lib/ratings import is pre-existing, unrelated); `npm test` 286/286 pass incl. the 3 new tests; `npm run build` succeeds and stays within the JS-size budget (no JS added). Inspected .svelte-kit/output/client/manifest.webmanifest: all 5 shortcuts -> /icons/icon-shortcut-192.png, none reference the transparent /icons/icon-192.png; asset ships to build/icons/. Build output (build/, .svelte-kit/) is gitignored so not committed. Committed on branch fix/notif-name-and-pwa-shortcut-icons as b7c6d27. Did NOT touch mgmt/backend (FEAT-001).
